Capture a lead when they sign-up or fill an optin form. This endpoint is used to track leads and sign-ups. It's not for tracking the actual sales and commissions.

Sign-ups are tracked as leads in FirstPromoter so when a person referred by the promoter/affiliate signs up, a new referral should be added inside FirstPromoter **(you can see them inside the `Referrals` section as `Leads`)**.

Assign sales and commissions to your promoters. To track sales and generate commissions correctly, you need to use this API call each time a non-zero amount sale is processed in your system, even if it comes from a recurring charge or one-time charge. <Note>To avoid fraudulent sales, we don't use JS conversion pixels to track sales, which are very unreliable and can be easily faked. The refund call is similar to the sale call. It works the same way, except that it generates negative commissions. **HTTP Request**
`POST https://api.firstpromoter.com/api/v2/track/refund`

This call will mark the customer as cancelled and will decrease the MRR generated by them. **HTTP Request**
`POST https://api.firstpromoter.com/api/v2/track/cancellation`
